products.name: Online Lottery Ticket Sales Platform (B2C)
products.description: A digital platform (app and website) enabling consumers to remotely purchase legally sanctioned lottery tickets in the U.S. and international jurisdictions. The platform is developed and operated by the company and requires regulatory compliance, digital infrastructure, and secure transaction processing.

products.name: Business-to-Business Lottery Ticket Sales API (B2B)
products.description: An API-based service allowing commercial partners in permitted jurisdictions to purchase legally operated lottery games for resale to end users. This service is delivered digitally and requires integration with partner systems and compliance with local regulations.

products.name: Lottery Data Services
products.description: Provision of real-time lottery results, jackpots, and related data to digital publishers and media organizations via subscription and data feeds. This service is delivered digitally and relies on proprietary technology for data aggregation and distribution.

products.name: Online Lottery Ticket Sales in Mexico and Latin America
products.description: Operation of licensed online lottery and gaming platforms in Mexico and Latin America, including the sale of Mexican National Lottery draw games, instant win tickets, proprietary scratch games, and access to online casino and sportsbook gaming. Requires regulatory licensing and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Sweepstakes Platform and Administration Services
products.description: Operation and administration of sweepstakes campaigns, primarily for charitable organizations, including platform management and prize fulfillment. Delivered digitally and involves compliance with sweepstakes and charitable gaming regulations.

products.name: Sports Content Platform (Sports.com)
products.description: A digital platform and app providing sports content, live streaming of sporting events, and community engagement for sports fans globally. Delivered via web and mobile app, leveraging partnerships for content rights and distribution.

products.name: Sports Data Distribution (via Sports.com)
products.description: Distribution of sports data products, including exclusive regional rights (previously held) for third-party sports data, sold through digital channels to publishers and partners. Requires digital infrastructure and data licensing agreements.

products.name: Banking Services
products.description: Comprehensive domestic banking services for individuals, businesses, municipalities, and non-profit organizations, including deposit accounts and lending products, delivered through physical financial centers and digital channels, and regulated by state and federal authorities.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Investment advisory, consulting, and management services for individuals and municipal entities, provided through registered investment advisory firms and broker-dealer subsidiaries, requiring regulatory compliance and professional financial expertise.

products.name: Insurance Services
products.description: A full range of insurance products and services, including personal and commercial insurance, delivered through licensed insurance agencies and requiring compliance with state insurance regulations.

products.name: Equipment Financing
products.description: Equipment financing solutions for businesses, provided through a specialized subsidiary, involving the extension of credit and leasing arrangements for business equipment acquisitions.

products.name: Turnkey Infrastructure Construction Services
products.description: Comprehensive site preparation and infrastructure construction services for residential, commercial, industrial, municipal, and state projects, delivered primarily through in-house skilled labor and specialized equipment. Services include planning, preparation, installation, and development of infrastructure systems.

products.name: Wet Utility Installation Services
products.description: Installation of water, sewer, and stormwater systems for new developments and infrastructure projects, requiring specialized crews and equipment for underground utility work.

products.name: Grading and Site Preparation Services
products.description: Grading, site clearing, and erosion control services for construction sites, involving heavy equipment and skilled operators to prepare land for development.

products.name: Drilling and Blasting Services
products.description: Drilling and controlled blasting for site preparation and underground utility installation, performed by specialized teams using regulated equipment and safety protocols.

products.name: Paving Services
products.description: Asphalt and concrete paving for roads, highways, and site developments, utilizing in-house crews and, increasingly, company-owned asphalt plants for material supply.

products.name: Materials Supply (Asphalt and Aggregates)
products.description: Production and supply of asphalt and aggregates for internal projects and third-party customers, enabled by company-owned asphalt plants and planned concrete casting facilities.

products.name: Concrete Contracting and Soil Stabilization Services
products.description: Concrete contracting, reclamation, and soil stabilization services for infrastructure and site development projects, delivered by specialized teams and equipment.

products.name: Digital Video Recording Solutions for Law Enforcement
products.description: Development, manufacture, and sale of in-car and body-worn digital video and audio recording systems (including EVO-HD, DVM-800, DVM-800 Lite, FirstVu Pro, FirstVu II, FirstVu HD) and integrated auto-activation technology (VuLink) for law enforcement and security agencies. Delivered as physical hardware with optional cloud-based evidence management and extended warranty services.

products.name: Digital Video Recording Solutions for Commercial Fleets and Mass Transit
products.description: Manufacture and sale of in-car digital video event recorders (EVO Fleet, FLT-250, DVM-250 Plus) and cloud-based fleet management software (FleetVu Manager) for commercial fleet and mass transit operators. Delivered as hardware and web-based software for driver safety, asset tracking, and liability management.

products.name: Cloud-Based Evidence and Fleet Management Software
products.description: Provision of subscription-based, web-hosted platforms (EVO Web Portal for law enforcement, FleetVu Manager for commercial fleets) for digital video evidence management, playback, archiving, reporting, and fleet tracking. Delivered as digital-only SaaS solutions, often bundled with hardware sales.

products.name: Disinfectant and Personal Protective Equipment Products
products.description: Sale of Shield™ disinfectant and related personal protective equipment products for law enforcement, security, and commercial customers. Delivered as physical safety products.

products.name: Live Event Ticketing Marketplace
products.description: Operation of TicketSmarter.com, an online and mobile platform for primary and secondary ticket sales and resale for concerts, sports, theatre, and performing arts events. Delivered as a digital marketplace, generating revenue from service charges and ticket sales.

products.name: Live Event Production and Promotion Services
products.description: Production and promotion of live music, sports, and private events at third-party venues, including artist booking, ticketing, staging, vendor sourcing, on-site operations, and day-of production management. Delivered as in-person event services through Kustom 440.

products.name: Retail Footwear Sales
products.description: Sale of branded footwear through company-operated retail stores and e-commerce platforms under banners such as Journeys, Journeys Kidz, Little Burgundy, Schuh, and Johnston & Murphy. Products are sourced from third-party manufacturers and delivered via physical stores and digital channels.

products.name: Wholesale Footwear Distribution
products.description: Design, sourcing, marketing, and distribution of branded and licensed footwear (including Johnston & Murphy, Dockers, Wrangler, STARTER, and formerly Levi's) to external wholesale customers such as department stores, specialty stores, and e-commerce retailers. Products are manufactured by third parties and distributed through wholesale channels.

products.name: Retail Apparel and Accessories Sales
products.description: Sale of branded apparel and accessories, primarily through Johnston & Murphy retail stores and select e-commerce channels. Products are targeted mainly at men, with some offerings for women, and are delivered via physical retail and online.

products.name: Wholesale Apparel and Accessories Distribution
products.description: Wholesale distribution of Johnston & Murphy branded apparel and accessories to department stores, specialty stores, and e-commerce retailers. Products are designed and sourced by the company and manufactured by third parties.

products.name: Abuse-Resistant Opioid Pain Products (TAAP Platform)
products.description: Pharmaceutical products for severe pain relief using the Trypsin Activated Abuse Protection (TAAP) prodrug technology, which releases active opioid drugs only when ingested and exposed to digestive enzymes, deterring abuse via non-oral routes. These are physically manufactured, regulated, and require clinical development and controlled substance handling.

products.name: Overdose Protection Opioid Products (MPAR Platform)
products.description: Combination pharmaceutical products that integrate TAAP opioid prodrugs with the Multi-Pill Abuse Resistant (MPAR) technology, using a trypsin inhibitor (nafamostat) to limit opioid activation in overdose scenarios. These are physically manufactured, regulated, and require clinical development and controlled substance handling.

products.name: TAAP and MPAR Amphetamine Products
products.description: Pharmaceutical products under development applying TAAP and MPAR technologies to amphetamines, aiming to deter abuse and overdose of stimulant medications. These are physically manufactured, regulated, and require clinical development.

products.name: Nafamostat for Infection and Pulmonary Diseases
products.description: Pharmaceutical products based on nafamostat, developed for the treatment of infections (including COVID-19) and pulmonary/lung diseases. These are physically manufactured, regulated, and require clinical development.

products.name: Fiber Lasers
products.description: High-performance fiber lasers manufactured using proprietary semiconductor diodes and specialty optical fibers, offered in various power levels and wavelengths for industrial, medical, and advanced applications. Delivered as modules, rack-mounted, or tabletop units.

products.name: Pulsed Lasers (Nanosecond, Picosecond, Femtosecond)
products.description: Pulsed lasers with nanosecond, picosecond, and femtosecond durations, used for precision materials processing, marking, engraving, microelectronics, and scientific applications. Manufactured using proprietary fiber and diode technology.

products.name: Direct Diode Lasers and Packaged Semiconductor Diodes
products.description: Direct diode lasers and packaged semiconductor diodes, used as standalone light sources or as pump sources in fiber lasers, manufactured using in-house semiconductor foundry and packaging technologies.

products.name: Laser Systems (Integrated and Custom)
products.description: Integrated and custom-developed laser systems, including handheld welding systems, multi-axis cutting and welding systems, and specialized solutions for manufacturing, medical, and cleaning applications. Systems are assembled from in-house lasers and components.

products.name: Laser-Based Surface Cleaning and Preparation Systems
products.description: Laser-based systems for surface preparation and cleaning, providing a dry, media-free alternative to abrasive or chemical cleaning for industrial applications. Delivered as standalone or integrated systems.

products.name: Medical Laser Systems and Consumable Fibers
products.description: Complete medical laser systems and consumable fibers, primarily for urology and aesthetic procedures, based on proprietary fiber and diode laser technology. Sold to medical device manufacturers and end users.

products.name: Laser Accessories and Optical Components
products.description: Accessories and complementary products for lasers, including optical fiber delivery cables, fiber couplers, beam switches, optical processing heads, in-line sensors, and chillers. Manufactured in-house and sold for use with IPG lasers and systems.

products.name: Counter-Unmanned Aircraft System (C-UAS) Solutions
products.description: Specialized laser-based counter-UAS (unmanned aircraft system) solutions, such as the CROSSBOW™ system, offered to government and authorized parties for defense and security applications.

products.name: Robotic Welding and Automation Solutions
products.description: Laser and non-laser robotic welding and automation solutions provided through subsidiary Genesis Systems Group, integrating IPG lasers and automation technologies for industrial manufacturing.

products.name: Earth Observation Data & Analytics Services
products.description: Provision of high-resolution satellite imagery and analytics, including persistent monitoring, tasking, archived data, and AI-powered insights, delivered digitally via web platforms and APIs to government and commercial customers. Data is captured by Satellogic's proprietary satellite constellation and processed using in-house and cloud-based infrastructure.

products.name: Constellation as a Service (CaaS)
products.description: Subscription-based access to dedicated satellite capacity or virtual constellations, allowing customers to task satellites for specific imaging needs and receive prioritized data delivery. Service is enabled by Satellogic's operational satellite fleet and managed through digital interfaces.

products.name: Satellite Sales and Sovereign Space Systems
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of complete high-resolution imaging satellites (including in-orbit assets), as well as turnkey sovereign space programs with technology and knowledge transfer, enabling customers to own and operate their own EO satellites. Satellogic provides assembly, integration, testing, and operational support, leveraging its vertically integrated manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Aleph Observer Platform
products.description: A digital platform for persistent, automated monitoring of sites of interest, featuring built-in analytics, change detection, and historical data cataloging. Delivered as a web-based and API-accessible service, leveraging Satellogic's satellite data and AI analytics.

products.name: Non-Earth Imagery (NEI) Services
products.description: Provision of high-resolution satellite imagery for in-orbit inspection and non-Earth targets, offered through exclusive partnerships with specialized customers. Service utilizes Satellogic's constellation and operational support for unique space-based imaging applications.

products.name: Microdisplay Components (AMLCD, LCOS, OLED, MicroLED)
products.description: Designs and manufactures miniature active-matrix liquid crystal (AMLCD), liquid crystal on silicon (LCOS), organic light emitting diode (OLED), and developing micro light emitting diode (MicroLED) displays. These are produced using proprietary processes, with manufacturing steps in the US, Europe, and Asia, and are sold as stand-alone components or integrated into higher-level assemblies.

products.name: Application Specific Optical Solutions (ASOS) Subsystems
products.description: Designs and manufactures integrated subsystems combining microdisplays, optics, electronics, and housings tailored for specific applications, especially in defense, industrial, and medical markets. These are ruggedized and built to meet stringent size, weight, power, and environmental requirements.

products.name: Integrated Headset Solutions (Defense, Industrial, Medical, Training & Simulation)
products.description: Develops and manufactures complete headset systems that integrate microdisplays, optics, and electronics for use in defense (e.g., pilot helmets, training simulators), industrial (field service), and medical (surgeon headsets) applications. These are delivered as finished products or licensed reference designs.

products.name: Display Modules and Higher-Level Assemblies (HLAs) for Defense Applications
products.description: Produces display modules and HLAs that integrate microdisplays, optics, and electronics into sealed, ruggedized units for use in military equipment such as weapon sights, pilot helmets, armored vehicle targeting systems, and soldier-borne systems.

products.name: Optical Components (Lenses, Backlights, Optical Assemblies)
products.description: Designs and supplies optical components such as lenses, backlights, and optical assemblies, either developed internally or licensed and manufactured by third parties, to complement microdisplay products and subsystems.

products.name: Customer-Funded Research and Development Services
products.description: Provides contract research and development services for custom product solutions, primarily for U.S. government agencies and commercial customers, focusing on advanced display and optical technologies. These contracts often lead to future production orders.

products.name: Technology Licensing and Royalties
products.description: Licenses proprietary headset reference designs, display technologies, and intellectual property to third parties, generating revenue through royalties and purchase commitments, particularly in industrial and consumer markets.

products.name: Silicon Carbide and GaN Materials
products.description: Manufactured silicon carbide bare wafers, epitaxial wafers, and gallium nitride (GaN) epitaxial layers on silicon carbide wafers, sold to external customers for use in manufacturing RF, power, and other semiconductor devices. Production involves advanced materials science and precision manufacturing in dedicated facilities.

products.name: Power Devices
products.description: Manufactured silicon carbide-based power semiconductor devices, including Schottky diodes, MOSFETs, and power modules, sold to customers and distributors for use in electric vehicles, charging infrastructure, power supplies, solar inverters, and industrial applications. Production requires complex semiconductor fabrication, assembly, and testing.

products.name: Payment Processing Services
products.description: Mastercard provides payment processing services that enable financial institutions and merchants to process electronic payments, including credit, debit, and prepaid card transactions. These services require regulated infrastructure and secure digital networks.

products.name: Authentication and Security Solutions
products.description: Mastercard offers authentication and security solutions to ensure secure transaction processing and compliance with regulatory standards, leveraging digital technology and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Data and Privacy Compliance Services
products.description: Mastercard provides services to help customers comply with privacy, data protection, and data localization regulations, utilizing digital compliance tools and secure data management systems.

products.name: Corporate Finance Advisory Services
products.description: Comprehensive advisory services for strategic, operational, financial, transactional, and capital needs, including transactions (diligence, investment banking, valuation), transformation (cost, data, HR, operations, revenue, strategy), and turnaround & restructuring (company and creditor advisory, insolvency, interim management). Delivered by teams of professionals through in-person consulting and financial analysis.

products.name: Forensic and Litigation Consulting Services
products.description: Multidisciplinary consulting services for risk, investigations, disputes, and regulatory matters, including construction and environmental solutions, data analytics, dispute advisory, healthcare risk management, and risk & investigations. Delivered by expert teams using technology-enabled solutions and in-person consulting, often in highly regulated industries.

products.name: Economic Consulting Services
products.description: Expert economic analysis and testimony for antitrust, competition, financial economics, and international arbitration matters, including complex modeling, valuation, and damages analysis. Delivered by economists and industry experts through research, modeling, and expert witness services for legal, regulatory, and policy proceedings.

products.name: Technology Consulting and Digital Risk Management Services
products.description: Technology-driven consulting services for digital insights, risk management, AI and data services, including blockchain and digital assets, information governance, privacy and security, investigations, litigation support, and M&A data management. Delivered by technologists, data scientists, and legal experts using proprietary software platforms and digital tools.

products.name: Strategic Communications Services
products.description: Consulting services to develop and execute communications strategies for corporate reputation, financial communications, and public affairs, including crisis management, investor relations, and government relations. Delivered by communications professionals through advisory, campaign management, and digital analytics.

products.name: Retail Insurance Brokerage Services
products.description: Brokerage and placement of a broad range of insurance products—including property & casualty, employee benefits, and personal insurance—for commercial, public, professional, and individual customers, delivered primarily through in-person and digital channels without assuming underwriting risk.

products.name: Automobile and Recreational Vehicle Dealer Services (F&I)
products.description: Provision of non-insurance warranty services and products, including finance and insurance (F&I) offerings, to automobile and recreational vehicle dealers, delivered through specialized dealer service operations.

products.name: Specialty Insurance Program Management (MGU Services)
products.description: Development, underwriting, and management of targeted insurance programs for niche industries, trade groups, and market segments, acting as managing general underwriters (MGUs) and distributing through retail agencies, affinity groups, and direct channels.

products.name: Wholesale Insurance Brokerage
products.description: Wholesale brokerage, binding, and underwriting services for excess and surplus commercial and personal lines insurance, focusing on specialized or hard-to-place risks, delivered through a global network of independent agents and brokers.

products.name: Specialty Insurance Solutions (Affinity, Captives, Reinsurance, Warranty, Life & Health)
products.description: Provision of specialty insurance solutions including affinity group programs, captive insurance management, reinsurance, travel/accident, warranty, and life & health products, delivered through specialty business units and administrative services.

products.name: Flood Insurance Carrier Services
products.description: Operation of a write-your-own flood insurance carrier, underwriting policies under the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) and excess flood policies, with risk ceded to FEMA or reinsured in the private market.

products.name: Semiconductor Test Automation Systems
products.description: Automated equipment and systems that move semiconductor devices, control temperature during test, and optimize throughput and efficiency in high-volume production. These systems are physically manufactured and integrate robotics and active thermal management technology.

products.name: Inspection and Metrology Equipment
products.description: Advanced equipment for optical and infrared inspection and metrology of semiconductor devices, including molded, wafer-level, and bare die packages. These systems are physically manufactured and use deep learning and pattern recognition to improve yield and quality.

products.name: Semiconductor Automated Test Equipment (ATE)
products.description: Instrumentation and universal platform systems for testing semiconductor devices in RF, digital, mixed signal, and power management applications. These are complex, physically manufactured systems used for both wafer-level and packaged device testing.

products.name: Interface Solutions (Test Contactors and Probe Cards)
products.description: Consumable products including test contactors and power probe cards that provide the electrical interface between test equipment and semiconductor devices. These are physically manufactured, device-specific, and replaced frequently in production environments.

products.name: Software Analytics for Semiconductor Manufacturing
products.description: AI-driven digital twin software platform offering data analytics and machine learning for process control, yield optimization, defect detection, and equipment monitoring. Delivered as digital software solutions integrated with manufacturing systems.

products.name: Semiconductor Test and Inspection Services
products.description: Global services including device applications, spares, board repair, service agreements, and both virtual and on-site support for installed equipment. Delivered by skilled field engineers and supported by a web-based customer portal.

products.name: Middle-Market Debt Financing
products.description: Provision of debt capital to U.S. middle-market companies, primarily through standalone first lien loans, second lien loans, and unitranche loans. These are typically floating rate loans, structured and underwritten by the company, and require significant financial capital, credit analysis, and ongoing portfolio management.

products.name: Mezzanine and Unsecured Debt Investments
products.description: Selective investment in mezzanine loans, unsecured debt, and bonds to middle-market companies. These investments are typically subordinated, carry higher risk and yield, and may include structured equity features. Delivery requires financial structuring expertise and risk management.

products.name: Equity and Warrant Investments
products.description: Provision of equity capital to portfolio companies, typically as a minority investor, through direct equity investments, preferred stock, or warrants, often as part of a broader debt investment relationship. These are structured to provide upside participation and may include protective provisions.

products.name: Managerial Assistance Services
products.description: Provision of managerial assistance to portfolio companies, including consulting, board participation, and organizational or financial guidance. This service is offered as required by BDC regulations and may generate fee income, delivered through in-person or remote advisory by investment professionals.

products.name: Rubrik Security Cloud (RSC)
products.description: A cloud-native SaaS platform that provides unified data security, backup, recovery, and threat analytics for enterprise, unstructured, cloud, SaaS, and identity data. Delivered as a subscription, it automates policy management, threat detection, and orchestrates rapid recovery across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

products.name: Rubrik Agent Cloud (RAC)
products.description: A SaaS-based AI operations platform that monitors, controls, and remediates agentic actions to accelerate enterprise AI transformation. It provides dynamic oversight and recovery for AI agent workflows, helping organizations manage AI adoption securely.

products.name: Data Protection Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive backup and recovery services for enterprise, unstructured, cloud, and SaaS application data, including physical systems, databases, NAS, and major SaaS platforms. Delivered via cloud-native SaaS and Rubrik-branded appliances, with features like air-gapped, immutable, access-controlled backups.

products.name: Data Threat Analytics and Security
products.description: AI-powered threat detection, anomaly detection, threat monitoring, and threat hunting services that identify, analyze, and remediate data security risks, including ransomware and insider threats. Delivered as part of the SaaS platform, integrating machine learning and threat intelligence.

products.name: Identity Security and Recovery
products.description: Continuous monitoring, risk remediation, and rapid recovery for identity provider services (e.g., Microsoft Active Directory, EntraID, Okta), including attack rollback and orchestrated recovery. Delivered as SaaS, it protects both human and non-human identities across hybrid environments.

products.name: Cyber Recovery Solutions
products.description: Orchestrated cyber recovery, simulation, threat containment, and forensic recovery services to improve cyber readiness and incident response. Includes recovery plan validation, malware quarantine, and Active Directory Forest Recovery, delivered via SaaS.

products.name: Data Security Posture Management (DSPM)
products.description: Services for discovering, classifying, and monitoring sensitive data, user access, and data risks to strengthen cyber posture and support compliance. Delivered as part of the SaaS platform, leveraging automation and AI for continuous monitoring.

products.name: Rubrik-branded Appliances
products.description: Physical servers pre-loaded with Rubrik software, used by customers to deploy on-premises data protection and security solutions. Manufactured by Supermicro and sold through channel partners.

products.name: Ruby AI Agent for Cyber Resilience
products.description: An AI agent designed to automate and scale data security operations, providing intelligent automation, query augmentation, and integration with multiple large language models. Delivered as part of the SaaS platform to enhance productivity and bridge user skill gaps.

products.name: Primary Storage Software and Systems
products.description: Software and hardware solutions for high-performance storage of unstructured data, including all-flash and hybrid flash/disk systems, delivered as appliances combining Quantum software with servers. Used for AI, analytics, video editing, and surveillance workloads.

products.name: Secondary Storage Software and Systems
products.description: Software and hardware solutions for scalable, durable, and cost-efficient storage, including object storage, backup appliances, and tape storage systems for data lakes, backup, and long-term archiving. Delivered as appliances or systems integrating Quantum software and hardware.

products.name: Asset Management Software
products.description: Software for indexing, cataloging, AI data enrichment, and workflow orchestration of unstructured data, making data searchable and accessible for business insights. Delivered as standalone or integrated software solutions.

products.name: Tape Drives and Media
products.description: Standalone linear-tape open (LTO) tape drives and LTO media for data protection and archiving, sold as devices and consumables for use in tape storage systems or standalone applications. Manufactured and distributed globally.

products.name: Support and Professional Services
products.description: Comprehensive support, deployment, consulting, education, and managed services for Quantum products, including 24x7x365 global support, installation, integration, maintenance, and project management. Delivered by Quantum and third-party providers worldwide.

products.name: Quantum-as-a-Service
products.description: Subscription-based or cloud-delivered data management and storage solutions, leveraging Quantum's technology and expertise, including proactive remote monitoring and analytics via cloud-based platforms.

products.name: NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System
products.description: A non-invasive, office-based transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) medical device system for treating major depressive disorder (MDD), obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), and anxious depression. The system is manufactured using outsourced components and assemblies, and is delivered to healthcare providers for in-office use.

products.name: NeuroStar Treatment Sessions
products.description: Recurring in-office treatment sessions using the NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System, delivered by healthcare providers to patients with MDD, OCD, or anxious depression. These sessions are sold as a service to clinics and treatment centers, and are a primary recurring revenue stream.

products.name: Greenbrook Treatment Centers (TMS Therapy Services)
products.description: Operation of outpatient mental health service centers specializing in providing in-person TMS therapy using the NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System and other FDA-cleared TMS devices. Services are delivered by clinical staff at company-operated centers across the U.S.

products.name: SPRAVATO Therapy Services
products.description: Provision and administration of SPRAVATO (esketamine nasal spray) therapy for adults with treatment-resistant depression or depressive symptoms with acute suicidal ideation, delivered at Greenbrook Treatment Centers by clinical staff.

products.name: Medication Management Services
products.description: Medication management services for mental health disorders, including evaluation and ongoing management of psychiatric medications, facilitated at select Greenbrook Treatment Centers by healthcare professionals.

products.name: Service, Repair, and Extended Warranty Contracts
products.description: Provision of service, repair, and extended warranty contracts for the NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System, including maintenance and technical support, delivered by field service engineers to customer sites.

products.name: Cloud-Based Practice Management Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based software solutions that support practice management for providers using the NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System, enhancing convenience for providers and patients through digital tools and resources.

products.name: Mobile Device Lifecycle Solutions
products.description: End-to-end solutions for mobile devices, including insurance, extended service contracts, device repair, refurbishment, trade-in and upgrade programs, technical support, and resale of repaired or refurbished devices. Delivered through partnerships with carriers, OEMs, retailers, and supported by proprietary technology and logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Extended Service Contracts for Consumer Electronics and Appliances
products.description: Insurance and administrative services for extended service contracts covering consumer electronics and appliances, providing repair or replacement after manufacturer warranty expiration. Delivered via partnerships with retailers and OEMs, supported by digital platforms and supply chain management.

products.name: Financial Services Protection Products
products.description: A suite of insurance and value-added financial services for financial institutions, including credit card benefits, packaged bank account benefits, travel coverage, and credit insurance. Delivered through underwriting, claims processing, and digital integration with financial partners.

products.name: Vehicle Protection Services
products.description: Insurance and administrative services for vehicle service contracts and ancillary products covering automobiles, trucks, recreational vehicles, powersports, and commercial equipment. Includes mechanical breakdown coverage, guaranteed asset protection, and risk management solutions for commercial equipment lenders. Delivered through auto dealers, agents, and financial institutions, supported by digital and experiential training and technology integration.

products.name: Lender-Placed Homeowners, Manufactured Housing, and Flood Insurance
products.description: Insurance products providing collateral protection to lenders and mortgage servicers when homeowners fail to maintain required insurance, including fire, hazard, and flood coverage for residential and manufactured housing. Delivered via proprietary insurance-tracking systems integrated with client systems, and includes REO insurance for foreclosed properties.

products.name: Voluntary Homeowners, Manufactured Housing, and Condominium Insurance
products.description: Voluntary insurance products for homeowners, manufactured housing, and condominiums, providing structural, contents, and liability coverage. Sold in select states through lenders, builders, affinity partners, and specialty agents.

products.name: Renters Insurance Solutions
products.description: Integrated insurance solutions for renters, covering personal belongings and liability for single and multi-family rental properties. Includes billing, tracking, and receivables management platforms for property managers and owners.

products.name: Flood Insurance Administration (NFIP)
products.description: Administration services for the U.S. National Flood Insurance Program, including premium collection and claims processing, fully reinsured to the U.S. government. Delivered as a fee-based service to government clients.

products.name: Special Bar Quality (SBQ) Steel Bars
products.description: Custom-manufactured alloy, carbon, and micro-alloy steel bars produced using electric arc furnace technology, made to restrictive chemical compositions and high internal purity levels for demanding mechanical applications. Products are delivered in various chemistries, lengths, and finishes to industrial, automotive, aerospace & defense, and energy markets.

products.name: Seamless Mechanical Steel Tubes
products.description: Seamless mechanical tubing made from alloy, carbon, and micro-alloy steel, produced at integrated manufacturing facilities using advanced metallurgical processes, tailored for critical applications in industrial, automotive, aerospace & defense, and energy sectors.

products.name: Steel Billets
products.description: Steel billets produced from recycled steel using electric arc furnace technology, serving as intermediate products for further processing or as finished goods for customers in various end-markets.

products.name: Manufactured Precision Steel Components
products.description: Precision steel components manufactured from bar and tube products at downstream facilities, providing ready-to-finish parts that simplify vendor management and supply chains, primarily for automotive, industrial, aerospace & defense, and energy customers.

products.name: Raw Material Recycling and Scrap Sales
products.description: Management of raw material recycling programs, including the sale of scrap metal not used internally to third parties, leveraging expertise in raw materials and an extensive supply network.

products.name: DC Power Systems
products.description: Integrated DC power generation systems (5 kW to 50 kW) designed and manufactured in-house, available in diesel, natural gas, LPG/propane, and renewable fuel formats, used for prime and backup power in telecommunications, military, marine, industrial, and other applications. Delivered as stationary or mobile units, often with automated controls and remote monitoring.

products.name: DC Hybrid Power Systems
products.description: Power systems that integrate DC generators with advanced battery storage (typically lithium-ion) to optimize fuel efficiency and provide reliable power in off-grid or bad-grid applications, primarily for telecommunications and military markets. Includes remote monitoring and control for operational efficiency.

products.name: DC Solar Hybrid Power Systems
products.description: Stationary power systems combining DC hybrid power systems with solar photovoltaic modules and custom charge controllers, designed for off-grid and bad-grid applications in telecommunications, residential, and commercial markets. Includes features like hybrid power panels, photovoltaic arrays, shelters, and lightning protection.

products.name: Mobile Power Systems
products.description: Lightweight, compact DC power systems designed for mobile applications such as EV charging, robotics, communications, and security, delivered as portable units for use in field or remote locations.

products.name: Natural Gas and LPG-Powered Generators
products.description: Stationary and mobile DC generators powered by natural gas or LPG/propane, designed for low emissions and long life, used in telecommunications, residential, and commercial applications, including microgrids and backup power.

products.name: Electric Vehicle Charging Systems
products.description: Grid-independent electric vehicle charging systems, including natural gas-powered fast chargers and combined heat and power (CHP) units, designed for residential and roadside use, providing fast charging and backup power, with waste heat recovery for home heating.

products.name: Mini-Grid Hybrid Power Systems
products.description: Hybrid power systems (5 kW to 25 kW) integrating natural gas or LPG generators with solar and battery storage, designed to provide continuous electricity for small residential, commercial, or community applications in off-grid or bad-grid rural areas.

products.name: Aftermarket and Service Parts
products.description: Extensive inventory and sale of aftermarket and service parts for DC power systems, sold directly to customers or through a network of qualified service providers to ensure product longevity and minimize downtime.

products.name: Installation, Maintenance, and Warranty Services
products.description: Installation, commissioning, maintenance, and warranty support for all DC power systems, provided through a network of factory-trained dealers and service providers, including remote monitoring, preventative maintenance scheduling, and technical support.

products.name: Remote Monitoring and Network Management Services
products.description: Remote monitoring and management services for DC power systems using proprietary telematics tools (Supra Controller™ and MCS2020), providing automated alerts, maintenance management, and real-time diagnostics to customers globally.

products.name: Manufactured Structural Components
products.description: Factory-built structural building products such as roof and floor trusses, wall panels, and engineered wood, designed and fabricated to order using specialized equipment and delivered to job sites for residential construction. Production is performed in controlled manufacturing facilities to ensure quality and efficiency.

products.name: Modular and Manufactured Homes
products.description: Manufacture and delivery of modular and manufactured homes, including both standard and semi-custom designs, built in temperature-controlled facilities under proprietary brands and delivered to homebuilders or developers. Homes are constructed to HUD or local codes and range in size and configuration.

products.name: Windows, Doors, and Millwork
products.description: Manufacture, assembly, and distribution of vinyl windows, pre-hung interior and exterior doors, and custom millwork (including trim and mouldings), produced in company facilities and distributed to builders. Includes proprietary products such as Synboard PVC millwork.

products.name: Lumber and Lumber Sheet Goods
products.description: Distribution of dimensional lumber, plywood, and oriented strand board (OSB) used for on-site house framing and construction. Products are sourced from multiple suppliers and delivered to builders as needed.

products.name: Specialty Building Products
products.description: Distribution of specialty building materials such as siding (vinyl, composite, wood), exterior trim, metal studs, cement, roofing, insulation, wallboard, ceilings, cabinets, and hardware, sourced from third-party suppliers and delivered to professional builders.

products.name: Professional Installation and Turn-Key Services
products.description: Provision of installation, turnkey framing, and shell construction services for building products, including project management, scheduling, and on-site labor, enabling builders to outsource key construction tasks for efficiency and cost control.

products.name: Digital Homebuilding Software Solutions
products.description: Development and sale of software products for drafting, estimating, quoting, and virtual home design, primarily through the Paradigm subsidiary, serving retailers, distributors, manufacturers, and homebuilders to improve efficiency and competitiveness.

products.name: Eyeglasses and Sunglasses
products.description: Designer-quality eyeglasses and sunglasses, including both prescription and non-prescription lenses, designed in-house and manufactured through a vertically integrated supply chain. Products are sold directly to customers online and in retail stores, with options for lens enhancements and regular new collections.

products.name: Contact Lenses
products.description: A comprehensive selection of contact lenses from leading third-party manufacturers, offered through both online and retail channels, providing customers with access to popular and advanced contact lens technologies.

products.name: Eye Exams and Vision Care Services
products.description: Comprehensive in-person eye exams provided in most retail stores by employed or affiliated optometrists, utilizing advanced technology, as well as telehealth services such as the Virtual Vision Test app for prescription renewal.

products.name: Lens Replacement and Enhancements
products.description: Replacement of lenses in existing frames and a variety of lens enhancements, including progressives, blue-light-filtering, polarization, light-responsive, and anti-fatigue options, custom-cut and inspected in Warby Parker's optical labs.

products.name: AI-Powered Intelligent Eyewear (in development)
products.description: Development of AI-powered intelligent eyewear in partnership with technology companies, aiming to deliver real-time personalized insights and expand beyond traditional glasses. These products are designed for all-day use and leverage emerging technologies.

products.name: CAR-NK Cell Therapies for Oncology
products.description: Off-the-shelf cell therapies using healthy adult donor-derived natural killer (NK) cells engineered with proprietary gene circuit technologies, designed to selectively target and kill cancer cells (including both blood cancers and solid tumors) while sparing healthy cells. These therapies are manufactured using GMP processes and delivered as allogeneic cell therapy infusions.

products.name: Gene Circuit Platform Technologies (Licensing and Partnerships)
products.description: A suite of proprietary synthetic biology gene circuit technologies (including Logic Gating, Multi-Arming, Regulator Dials, and Smart Sensors) that can be licensed or partnered for use in engineering cell and gene therapies across various modalities (NK cells, T cells, TILs, stem cells, AAV, mRNA) and disease areas beyond oncology, including regenerative medicine and genetic diseases. Delivered as technology transfer, research collaborations, or licensing agreements to external partners.

products.name: Cell Therapies for Regenerative Medicine (Partnered Programs)
products.description: Development of cell therapies incorporating gene circuit technologies for regenerative medicine applications, primarily through partnerships (e.g., with BlueRock Therapeutics). These therapies use engineered cells (such as stem cells) to repair or replace damaged tissues, with Senti providing gene circuit components and technical expertise.

products.name: Aggregates
products.description: Crushed stone and sand and gravel mined from aggregate sites, processed to various sizes and grades for construction applications. Produced through open pit mining or quarry blasting, then crushed and screened to customer specifications. Delivered locally due to high transportation costs.

products.name: Ready-Mix Concrete
products.description: Ready-mix concrete produced at 135 plants, batched to customer specifications and delivered by truck for on-site pouring or for prefabricated building solutions. Production is localized due to rapid setting time, requiring proximity to customer sites.

products.name: Asphalt
products.description: Asphalt mix produced at 55 plants (including portable plants), using aggregates and liquid asphalt binder, primarily for road construction and maintenance. Delivered locally due to rapid setting properties.

products.name: Liquid Asphalt
products.description: Liquid asphalt (asphalt cement or oil) produced and supplied through nine terminal sites, including value-added polymer modified asphalt and emulsions. Used as a binder in asphalt mix for road construction and supplied to internal and third-party customers.

products.name: Contracting Services
products.description: Construction contracting services including general contracting, aggregate laydown, asphalt paving, concrete construction, site development, grading, and bridge construction. Services are provided for public infrastructure and private development projects, often leveraging internal materials supply.

products.name: Cement Supply and Storage
products.description: Retail sales and distribution of cement, primarily in Alaska and Hawaii, through strategically located storage facilities and distribution centers with storage and barging capabilities. Cement is sourced from third-party suppliers and sold to external customers.

products.name: Petroleum Recovery Services
products.description: Provision of petroleum recovery services, primarily through the Energy Services segment, involving the handling and recovery of petroleum products for external customers.

products.name: LB-102 (Oral Formulation)
products.description: An orally administered, small molecule benzamide antipsychotic drug developed for the treatment of schizophrenia, bipolar depression, adjunctive major depressive disorder (MDD), and potentially other neuropsychiatric disorders. It is manufactured via chemical synthesis and delivered as a once-daily oral tablet, requiring pharmaceutical manufacturing and regulatory approval.

products.name: LB-102 (Long-Acting Injectable Formulation)
products.description: A long-acting injectable (LAI) formulation of LB-102, designed to improve treatment adherence for patients with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and potentially other neuropsychiatric disorders. This formulation is produced through pharmaceutical manufacturing processes suitable for injectables and is intended for global commercialization, subject to regulatory approval.

products.name: Food and Food-Related Product Distribution (Foodservice)
products.description: Distribution of a broad line of food and food-related products—including custom-cut meat and seafood, frozen foods, refrigerated products, dry groceries, disposables, and cleaning supplies—to independent and chain restaurants, schools, hospitals, and other institutional food-away-from-home customers via a network of distribution centers.

products.name: Convenience Store Product Distribution
products.description: Wholesale distribution of consumer products—including cigarettes and nicotine products, candy, snacks, food (including fresh products), groceries, dairy, bread, beverages, general merchandise, and health and beauty care products—to convenience stores, drug stores, mass merchants, grocery stores, liquor stores, and other small format retailers in the U.S. and Canada.

products.name: Specialty Distribution (Candy, Snacks, Beverages, and Food Items)
products.description: National distribution of candy, snacks, beverages, and other food items to vending and office coffee service distributors, theaters, and retail locations, utilizing both truck delivery and small parcel 'pick and pack' direct-to-consumer shipping.

products.name: Value-Added Foodservice Solutions and Consulting
products.description: Provision of value-added services to foodservice customers, including product selection and procurement advice, menu development, and operational strategy consulting, leveraging industry knowledge and scale to enhance customer operations.

products.name: Health and Wellness Center Services
products.description: Comprehensive suite of health, wellness, aesthetics, and fitness services delivered through physical health and wellness centers onboard cruise ships and at destination resorts. Services include spa and body care, salon and skin care, fitness facilities and classes, pain management therapies, body composition analytics, weight loss and nutrition regimens, and advanced medi-spa treatments. Delivered by trained professionals in dedicated facilities, often requiring regulated infrastructure and in-person labor.

products.name: Retail Sales of Health, Wellness, and Aesthetics Products
products.description: Sale of branded health, wellness, aesthetics, and fitness products, including skincare, haircare, nutritional supplements, pain management devices, and related retail items. Products are sold onboard ships, at destination resorts, and through e-commerce and direct-to-home shipping programs. Sourced from leading brands and often sold as add-ons to service offerings.

products.name: Medi-Spa Services
products.description: Advanced cosmetic medical services provided by medically licensed professionals, including non-surgical procedures such as dermal fillers, skin tightening, weight reduction, IV therapies, and other leading medi-spa treatments. Delivered in dedicated medi-spa facilities within health and wellness centers, requiring specialized staff and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Fitness Services and Facilities
products.description: Provision of fitness centers, specialized fitness classes, and personal training services, including access to strength and cardiovascular equipment, boutique group classes, and one-on-one consultations. Delivered in dedicated fitness areas within health and wellness centers, requiring in-person instruction and physical infrastructure.

products.name: Nutrition and Weight Management Programs
products.description: Personalized nutritional and dietary consultation, weight management, nutrition coaching, detoxification regimens, and ongoing support. Programs may begin onboard or at resorts and continue post-visit via e-commerce and remote coaching, involving both in-person and digital delivery.

products.name: Thermal Suite and Hydrotherapy Experiences
products.description: Access to dedicated thermal suite areas offering hot and cold hydro-therapies, such as saunas, steam rooms, thermal loungers, snow rooms, and related amenities. Sold as passes to guests, delivered in specialized physical spaces within health and wellness centers.

products.name: Ammonium Nitrate (AN) and Nitric Acid Products
products.description: Manufactured primarily from natural gas, these products include ammonium nitrate (AN), low-density ammonium nitrate (LDAN), AN solution, and blended and regular nitric acid. They are produced at large-scale chemical facilities and delivered via rail, truck, barge, or pipeline to industrial customers for use in explosives, mining, quarrying, construction, and chemical manufacturing.

products.name: Urea Ammonium Nitrate (UAN) Fertilizers
products.description: Nitrogen-based liquid fertilizers produced from natural gas at dedicated chemical plants, sold to agricultural distributors, dealers, and end users for use in crop and forage production. Delivered via bulk transport and stored seasonally to meet agricultural demand cycles.

products.name: Ammonia (Industrial and Agricultural)
products.description: Anhydrous ammonia produced from natural gas at large-scale facilities, sold both as a fertilizer for agriculture and as a feedstock or specialty chemical for industrial applications, including emission control and specialty manufacturing. Distributed via pipeline, rail, and truck.

products.name: Other Nitrogen-Based Chemical Products
products.description: A range of other nitrogen-based chemicals and acid blends produced at chemical manufacturing facilities, including specialty blends for industrial and agricultural use. These products are tailored for specific customer applications and delivered through established distribution channels.

products.name: Oncology Research Services
products.description: Preclinical research services for pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, utilizing proprietary in vivo, ex vivo, analytical, and computational platforms based on Patient Derived Xenograft (PDX) models. Services include efficacy studies, bioinformatics analysis, and support for drug development, delivered through laboratory and computational work.

products.name: PDX Model Data Licensing
products.description: Licensing access to proprietary, highly characterized PDX model data and multi-omic datasets to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies for use in drug discovery and development. Delivered via data licenses and agreements.

products.name: Oncology Research SaaS Tools (Lumin Bioinformatics)
products.description: Annual subscription-based software platform providing access to proprietary oncology datasets and advanced analytics for computational cancer research. Delivered digitally as Software as a Service (SaaS).

products.name: Oncology Therapeutics Discovery and Development
products.description: Discovery and development of novel oncology therapeutics, including targeted therapies, immune oncology, and cell therapies, leveraging proprietary computational and experimental platforms. Delivered as drug candidates or out-licensed therapeutics.
